known_limitations: Gapless playback and crossfade are not implemented: the engine holds one title at a time.
A queue restored from a handoff or from a session saved before 4.12.0 with shuffle on has no remembered order: turning shuffle off leaves it as is.
Next or Previous from a headset while the app process has just been started by the system does nothing until the saved session is loaded.
The end-of-title sleep mode applies to whichever title is playing when it ends.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
